Hey friends 👋 Welcome to our little corner of the internet!

I'm Victoria, mama to sweet Aubrey and big sister to Alexandra, who has Williams Syndrome. Together, we share the everyday adventures that make life interesting, from home renovations and exotic pets to thrifting treasures, cozy meals, family memories, and everything in between. Around here, you'll find a little bit of chaos, a lot of laughter, and plenty of real-life moments.

Our goal is simple: bring a little light to your day, make you smile, and remind you that life's too short to be boring.

We're so happy you're here.
Stay weird ✌🏼
